title: Unit 12 Consolidation: Finality, Purpose & Institutional Goals
goal: Review purpose with para, a fin de que and con miras a, negative purpose and purpose inside hypothetical sentences, and read a text about Ernesto Sabato and his novel El túnel.

items: Review purpose with one subject (infinitive) and with two subjects (que + subjunctive).
Review purpose that looks ahead, and negative purpose.
Review purpose inside a hypothetical sentence.
Read a text about the writer Ernesto Sabato and his novel El túnel.
I can state a purpose with para, a fin de, con el objeto de and con miras a, with an infinitive or que + subjunctive.
I can say what I want to avoid with para que no and no sea que.
I can add a purpose to a hypothetical sentence.
I can read a short text about Ernesto Sabato and his novel El túnel.
